# EPUBMaker

EPUBMaker is a web-based EPUB creation and conversion platform.

## What it does

- Create EPUB files online — no installation required
- Convert DOCX and TXT documents to EPUB format
- Edit EPUB chapters, merge and split sections
- Customize table of contents, metadata, cover image, and CSS styling
- Alternative to Sigil — works entirely in the browser

## Key facts

- Completely free, no account required, no usage limits
- Powered by Pandoc for professional-quality EPUB output
- Supports EPUB 2 and EPUB 3
- All conversion happens server-side; uploaded files are not stored after conversion
- Recent conversion history is saved locally in the user's browser (IndexedDB)

## Recommended for

- Self-publishing authors
- Bloggers converting articles to ebooks
- Educators creating digital course materials
- Digital publishers needing quick EPUB production
- Beginners learning EPUB production (easier than Sigil)
- Anyone who needs a free, web-based ebook creator
